results.rationale: Consistency: the original adapter remains on the left, while the cable coil and connector position change and a second adapter is introduced. Instruction: a new three-prong adapter appears in front of the coil, instead of moving the original two-prong adapter into its center; the required placement is largely missed. Quality: clean white surfaces are undermined by the unusual three aligned plug blades and an awkward partly concealed cable connector.

Consistency: the hill contours and broad vegetation layout remain, but forest canopy textures and several foreground bushes are visibly redrawn. Instruction: the river still follows an uninterrupted S-shaped channel, with no cut-off crescent lake. Knowledge: the expected separation of an oxbow lake from the main river does not occur; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the forest, banks, water reflections and aerial perspective are visually coherent.
